title: Shopping starts with AI; our store must be agent-ready as PCs get pricier
summary: 55% of consumers use AI in discovery (NIQ); Shopify says AI discovery converts better than search; HP launched Experience AI; Newegg added Google UCP checkout. Q3 PC shipments fell 22.4% (Gartner).

points.headline: AI discovery converts, and rivals are opening agent checkout
points.detail: HP launched Experience AI; Newegg added Google UCP checkout; Shopify says AI discovery beats search; AI is entering Brazil’s shopping journey. Audit our catalog data and track AI traffic.

points.headline: PC volumes are collapsing while component costs push prices up
points.detail: Gartner reports Q3 shipments down 22.4% with higher ASPs; memory is being prioritised for servers. Plan pricing, stock and holiday promotions for a smaller, costlier market.

points.headline: Premium AI laptops now have a price anchor and a sales window
points.detail: Surface Laptop Ultra is priced at $2,599 pitching on-device AI agents. Benchmark our top-end AI PCs and merchandising against it.

points.headline: Marketplace sales events are lifting electronics demand early
points.detail: Prime Big Deal Days drove $9.86B US online sales with electronics up 85%; Amazon India sees a 35-40% festive spike. Line up PC promotions, stock and delivery promises.
